messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope things are going alright out there. Go ahead and send your blood pressure reading whenever you're ready.
Having trouble with that today. Put the cuff on twice and it just says ERR both times. Dunno what's going on with it.

Appreciate you letting me know. Device troubleshooting isn't something I'm able to help with — that's outside what I can do. I'll log that this week's reading was unavailable due to a device error. Your cuff's manual may have error code guidance, or the pharmacy where you got it might be able to take a look.
It's pretty old honestly. Think I might just need a new one. Are they expensive?

Pricing and where to get one isn't something I can advise on — I'd suggest calling your pharmacy or clinic for that. I'll go ahead and schedule your next check-in for seven days from now. If you get a working cuff before then, feel free to send a reading early.
Makes sense. I'll figure something out. Thanks.
Sounds good. Talk to you next week — take care of yourself.

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
